# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Bakken producers truck crude to Dakota Access as Enbridge's North Dakota line stays curtailed](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 21, 2026. Bakken producers are trucking crude to Dakota Access while Enbridge's 475,000 b/d North Dakota Pipeline stays curtailed over organic chloride testing, and at least two Midwest refiners have declared force majeure.
- [Midstream: Diamondback and KKR buy out Five Point's stake in the Deep Blue water network](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Downstream: US, China and Russia pledge more refined fuel supply but give no details](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Upstream: US rig count rises to 607, the highest since April 2024](https://uticamidstream.com/#rigs)
- [Upstream: Presidio enters the Permian with a $360 million Midland basin deal](https://uticamidstream.com/#presidio)
- [Cross-industry: China puts its first pure hydrogen pipeline into service](https://uticamidstream.com/#hydrogen)
